text:
We married in Cyprus in 2022. The advantage of a Cyprus marriage is that you don't need to translate the documents because misrad hapnim accepts documents that are officially released in English (you still have to get an apostille but Cypriot municipalities are familiar with that). At least that was the case when we started the process. 

We also hired a wedding planner. Not a must but it took a huge weight off our shoulders. We went with Stella Virdi in Paphos, so if you choose that city, I'd recommend to at least check her services out. 

Mazal Tov, and hope to have you guys over here soon :)
